recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7227 unless PHER later wants additional historical rationale in the narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-7227 was a Published/Persuasive PHER clarification from the DSTU1 ballot asking to replace the terse Immunization description with wording that states Immunization is a resource rather than a profile and explains why.
initial_application: Git commit 4e6d62c69367e6e3fcb59d84d016df913d35607e explicitly applied #7227 by changing the old Immunization spreadsheet definition from "Immunization event information" to a fuller vaccine administration record description. Later source refactors moved the authoritative definition into source/immunization/structuredefinition-Immunization.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-6230 is the direct separate-resource-versus-profile background issue and was resolved as No Change/Question answered with rationale for preferring a first-class Immunization resource. Current build scope includes Immunization as an active resource. Current StructureDefinition and narrative source identify Immunization as a resource, define its scope and key use cases, and explain its boundary with MedicationAdministration. The later FHIR-32960 reconciliation further preserved Immunization as the primary representation for vaccine administration while allowing MedicationAdministration only for workflow reasons when an equivalent Immunization is also exposed.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Adding a literal historical "not a profile" sentence would duplicate current source guidance and would not change implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: Directly asked whether Immunization should be a separate resource or MedicationAdministration profile and documents why a first-class resource was preferred.
Later clarified the current Immunization/MedicationAdministration boundary while preserving Immunization as the primary vaccine administration representation.
